name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 72 – Am 15
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 72b. Calls for the mobilisation of substantial Union funds and means to support Member States in reinforcing external border protection capabilities and infrastructure such as walls, means of surveillance, including aerial surveillance, and equipment; proposes that costs be covered to build and maintain physical border barriers that are an essential part of a comprehensive migration policy, which should aim at detaining asylum seekers at the external borders, preventing illegal entry and stopping human smuggling and hybrid attacks;
